_comment: The pages the bundle carries, and the files they are carried in.
The bundle is a copy of this site's documentation, made by the build. This file is
what says which pages are in it — and it is read by the build that writes the bundle
and by the checker that refuses a bundle that has fallen behind.
The 'sections' are the pages that must all be there. A page added to one of them and
not carried is a page the bundle has silently fallen behind on, and the checker says
so rather than letting it pass. The pages outside them — the command line for the
slides half, and the suite itself — are carried or not as this file says, because a
skill about the Word half has no reason to carry the slides half's command line.
The 'file' is the name the page is carried under. It is not the page's URL: the pages
are flattened into one directory, and two pages of different sections can want the
same name, so the names say which section a page is from where that is not obvious.
